description.value:
You funnel your gestalt wildshaping energy outward rather than inward, distorting and massively enlarging your form beyond its natural limits. Your size becomes Large. If there is insufficient space, you grow as large as you can safely fit. Your equipment and worn items grow proportionally with you. You gain 15 temporary hit points when you Cast the Spell, and you gain 5 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns while this spell is in effect. These two grants don't stack; only the highest current value applies.

While in this form, your unarmed Strikes and weapon Strikes deal an additional 2d6 damage of the damage type appropriate to the weapon or unarmed attack. Your reach increases by 5 feet. You are unable to cast polymorph spells while Grosteque Selfshape is active.

Heightened (+2) Your size increases by one step (to Huge, or as large as you can safely fit), the additional Strike damage increases by 1d6, and the temporary Hit Points you gain (both on cast and each turn) each increase by 5.
